overview.about: The Valero Texas Open is one of the oldest tournaments on the PGA Tour, played at TPC San Antonio the week before the Masters. Its firm, windy Hill Country layout and tricky greens offer strong preparation for Augusta, and it awards the final Masters spot each year.
overview.nextEvent: The next Valero Texas Open is played at TPC San Antonio's Oaks Course. Wind and firm conditions in the Texas Hill Country make it a demanding tune-up before the year's first major.
